title: Morning start
desc: Says hello when your day starts, gives you time to settle in, then helps you start

variables.name: morning_day
variables.desc: the day it last said hello

variables.name: morning_deadline
variables.desc: when your time to settle in is over (0: none)

signals.name: quiet_before
signals.desc: no activity for 3 hours before the last 2 minutes

next.desc: back after the night, not greeted today

greeting.desc: hello, by the time of day, and today's first task

ask_usr.title: Hello

values.hello: 'Good morning' if daytime < 720 else 'Good afternoon' if daytime < 1080 else 'Good evening'
values.first: ' First up: ' + next_task + '.' if next_task else ''
values.ask: 'Want a little time to settle in first, or start right away?' if daytime < 720 else 'Want to start a focus session?'
values.week: ' This week you wanted to: ' + shutdown_change if weekday == 0 and shutdown_change else ''

ask_usr.options: ['Start now', '15 min first', '30 min first', '60 min first'] if daytime < 720 else ['Start now']

do.name: morning_deadline
do.desc: the time picked, and a little more

set.name: morning_deadline
set.when: answer is not None and answer > 0

context.format: That's your morning time.{first} Shall we start?

values.first: ' First up: ' + next_task + '.' if next_task else ''
